is_anopheles.evidence: Studies wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. (comprising An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) and the Kisumu strain of An. gambiae s.s. (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions kdr L1014F mutation present at >=90% frequency in the Covè site description, but this is a citation of previous literature (references 21 and 22, Page 3). No genotyping of target markers was performed in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies were measured or reported in this paper.

african_field_population.evidence: Wild free-flying An. gambiae s.l. mosquitoes were collected in experimental huts in Covè, Southern Benin (Page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical study evaluating the efficacy and residual activity of Sovrenta 15WP IRS insecticide in laboratory bioassays and experimental huts (Page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: Experimental hut station in Covè, Southern Benin (7.21°N, 2.34°E) (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: IRS treatments were applied in April 2022 and the trial lasted 12 months (2022–2023) (Page 5).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is an independent GLP-compliant experimental hut study testing a novel insecticide formulation (Sovrenta 15WP).

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed as no marker genotyping was conducted.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy and 12-month residual activity of Sovrenta 15WP (isocycloseram), a novel isoxazoline insecticide, for indoor residual spraying against susceptible and pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in laboratory cone bioassays and experimental huts in Covè, Benin. The paper does not report any marker genotyping data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report genotyping or extractable genotype data for target insecticide resistance markers (L1014F mention in Covè site description is cited from previously published studies).
